proof: On a distinguishing coordinate set $S$, the $|\mathcal{H}|$ concepts have pairwise distinct binary restrictions.  There are only $2^{|S|}$ such restrictions, so $|\mathcal{H}|\le2^{|S|}$.  Minimizing over $S$ gives $\mathrm{R}(\mathcal{H})\ge\log|\mathcal{H}|$.
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, the distinguishing range is $n-1$, whereas $\log|\mathcal H|=\log n$.
name: Distinguishing Range / Log Size
